SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.artist
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
  AND (c.power = '*' OR c.power IS NULL);

SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.artist
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE lower(l.format) = 'commander'
  AND lower(l.status) = 'legal'
  AND (c.power IS NULL OR c.power = '*' OR trim(c.power) = '')
ORDER BY c.id;

SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.artist
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE lower(trim(l.format)) = 'commander'
  AND lower(trim(l.status)) = 'legal'
  AND (c.power IS NULL OR trim(c.power) = '' OR c.power = '*')
ORDER BY c.id;
